Title: Prompt Design and AI Response Quality in University Students’ Academic Learning Tasks
topic_text_preview: Prompt Design and AI Response Quality in University Students’ Academic Learning Tasks. This study explores how university students design single-turn prompts for academic learning tasks using AI tools. 19 students generated 57 prompts across exploratory, precise, and comprehensive scenarios. Using Bloom's Taxonomy and thematic analysis, the study found exploratory prompts often lacked clarity, while precise prompts produced highly relevant responses. Comprehensive prompts supported higher-order thinking but varied in specificity. Content analysis showed Perplexity outperformed ChatGPT in research tasks with real-time citations, while ChatGPT excelled in procedural queries. Students’ feedback emphasized clear, task-specific prompts, highlighting prompt literacy's role in effective AI-assisted learning. These findings advocate ethical prompt design to enhance human-AI interaction in education.

Title: Impact of Using ChatGPT on Students
topic_text_preview: Impact of Using ChatGPT on Students. This study examines the impact of ChatGPT on students' academic experiences across seven countries: Afghanistan, Oman, Pakistan, the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Canada. The objective is to analyze its influence on learning practices, study habits, and critical thinking skills. Data were collected through an online survey of 65 students from various educational backgrounds. Findings reveal both positive and negative impacts. ChatGPT enhanced access to information, personalized learning, and study management. However, concerns were raised about over- reliance, reduced critical thinking, and academic integrity issues. The research underscores the importance of guiding students to use AI tools responsibly to improve learning outcomes while preserving academic honesty and critical skills. These insights are valuable for educators, policymakers, and tech developers aiming to optimize AI in education.
